summary.headline: Astrological Questions 178–195
summary.text: Entries 178–195 from an astrological treatise, covering stellar power, combustion, advancing and retrograding stars, depressions and declines, journeys, the Sun in Aries decan rulers, battle, lawsuits, wealth, star natures, prediction, lunar significations, hidden things, action, and marriage. Authorities and planets named include Hermes, Zeus, Aphrodite, Ares, the Sun, and the Moon.
